manual_figures.note: Stale by design - shows how the freshness penalty works. Replace with the newest Microsoft/Mojang disclosure.
Take-Two restates shipped units every quarter - always pull the newest 10-Q.

manual_figures.source_name: Nintendo IR - Top Selling Title Sales Units
manual_figures.note: Nintendo publishes per-title units quarterly; decide whether the row is BotW only, TotK only, or the franchise sum, and say so in the report.
Elden Ring units are announced by press release; Dark Souls series units come from Bandai Namco IR decks.
Registered accounts are NOT players. The estimator converts them with registered_to_mau (see config/model.json) and the report must label the row as account-derived.
Riot stopped publishing MAU. Any number here is a third-party estimate and must be labelled as such.

manual_figures.source_name: Sensor Tower / AppMagic (paid) - HoYoverse does not disclose

manual_figures.note: Riot has disclosed VALORANT MAU in occasional anniversary posts - use the dated post, not aggregator blogs.
